title: [Master]-Modifying Description resets Quantity to 1 on Purchase Invoice Lines
summary: In the Dutch (NL) localization, changing the Description on a purchase invoice line no longer resets its Quantity to 1. The NL purchase invoice and credit memo subform pages were adjusted, and a test was added.
key_points: Fixes Quantity being reset to 1 when the Description is changed on purchase invoice lines
Changes are limited to the NL layer
Purch. Invoice Subform and Purch. Cr. Memo Subform pages were modified
Adds a regression test in the NL local tests
